logo_usage.clear_space: A protection area surrounds the logo (drawn for horizontal and vertical versions, no numeric value in the text); no text, image or graphic may enter it.
logo_usage.background_rules: Positive version on white is the general rule and mandatory for Commission publications. Textured or graphic backgrounds only if visibility and the protection area are respected, otherwise use a white or flat-colour protection area. On pictures use a solid colour background with sufficient contrast. Contrast between logo and background must meet basic accessibility standards.
logo_usage.misuse: Modifying, distorting, or separating the logo elements is prohibited; no drop shadows or special effects behind it; for EU-funded projects the EU emblem with funding statement is used, not the Commission logo.

notes: Colour values are read from the fills in the official SVG files; the 2025 guide does not list swatches (hence evidence observed, cmyk null). Logo and clear-space rules are from the guide pages 4 to 10. The older 2017 graphic charter is also linked from the visual identity page and was not used.
